finding.support: repo_config_host and repo_timeout_artifacts_off_control differ only in artifact capture: 121/135 vs 135/135, 416 s vs 122 s. The same effect reproduces inside the organizers' Docker image (repo_docker_reference, 119/135).
finding.timeout_sensitivity: With artifacts off, dropping 60 s to 10 s costs 2 of 135 tests at one worker (REQ-3.2.10, REQ-3.2.11) and 0 at four workers.
finding.failure_set_stability: Not stable between runs; single-run failure lists are indicative only.
